encoder.tracking: Greedy centroid matching with area ratio in[.25,4]; each previous component matched at most once
encoder.self_mask: Camera-visible own-body geom mask; baseline and current masks intersect
encoder.registration: Image-only Lucas-Kanade tracks, forward/backward consistency, RANSAC homography; own-body pixels excluded
encoder.ambiguous_frame_policy: Zero activity and reset reference/tracks; expose registration failure

scope: Retrospective screen on preserved moving-body images, no neural rerun or promotion
metrics: Intended-side cue activity, pre/post-cue false positives, registration confidence
